"""Pure offline retained registration/output/header/identity replay."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,sys
from mapping import map_capture
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else root/'reports/cc12_audio_endpoint_registration_readiness.json'
receipt=json.loads(path.read_text());count=0;unique=set()
def walk(value):
    global count
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        retained=value.get('retained_path','').replace('\\','/')
        if retained.startswith('local/cc12_audio_endpoint_registration_readiness/frozen/') and 'sha256' in value:
            b=(root/retained).read_bytes();assert len(b)==value['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==value['sha256'],value
            count+=1;unique.add(retained)
        for v in value.values():walk(v)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for v in value:walk(v)
walk(receipt)
capture=json.loads((root/receipt['complete_capture_pin']['retained_path']).read_text())
mapping=json.loads(json.dumps(map_capture(capture)))
assert mapping==receipt['derived_identity_mapping']
api=capture['all_state_MMDevice']['observed'];native=api['native_result']
assert api==receipt['current_MMDevice_all_state'] and api['state_mask']==15
assert native['AllStateRenderEnumHResult']=='00000000' and native['AllStateRenderGetCountHResult']=='00000000' and native['AllStateRenderCount']==0 and native['Endpoints']==[]
assert all(not d['EndpointReturned'] and d['HResult']=='80070490' for d in native['Defaults'])
header=next(p for p in capture['authoritative_local_header_pins'] if p['path'].endswith('mmdeviceapi.h'))
text=(root/header['retained_path']).read_text()
for name,value in [('DEVICE_STATE_ACTIVE',1),('DEVICE_STATE_DISABLED',2),('DEVICE_STATE_NOTPRESENT',4),('DEVICE_STATE_UNPLUGGED',8),('DEVICE_STATEMASK_ALL',15)]:
    match=re.search(r'#define\s+'+name+r'\s+(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)',text);assert match and int(match.group(1),16)==value
assert mapping['registry_record_count']==39 and mapping['registry_known_state_counts']=={'active':5,'unplugged':7,'not_present':27}
assert mapping['present_audio_endpoint_PnP_count']==0 and mapping['audio_endpoint_PnP_count']==9
assert all(d['Present'] and d['ProblemCode']==0 for d in mapping['present_media_mapping'])
assert mapping['render_interface_states']=={'Disabled':75,'Enabled':12}
assert mapping['audio_interface_states']=={'Disabled':229,'Enabled':24}
assert sum(bool(p['matching_audio_endpoint_PnP_ids']) for p in mapping['registry_to_PnP_mapping'])==8
assert all(d['State']=='Running' for d in receipt['narrow_inventory']['media_service_drivers'])
assert not receipt['finding']['normal_enable_or_default_target_identified'] and receipt['finding']['concrete_mutation_proposal'] is None
assert receipt['git']['prior_owned_receipts_unchanged']
for command in receipt['commands_and_raw_output_pins']:
    raw=(root/command['raw_stdout_pin']['retained_path']).read_bytes()
    assert command['exit_code']==0
    if command['label'] in ['all_state_MMDevice','narrow_audio_inventory']:
        observed=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'))
        assert observed==capture[command['label']]['observed']
